observations: Current PROGRAM_STATE makes sandbox-only testing authoritative; VPS/self-hosted/production test execution is forbidden.

hypotheses.claim: First synchronize the bridge/matrix substrate to fresh main and fresh candidate heads, repair deterministic worker installation, then consume exactly one E2B start for the refreshed multi-variant matrix.

fusion.why: It preserves sandbox-only authority, avoids premature semantic promotion, removes a known stale candidate, and converts one scarce E2B start into a discriminator across the competing String/Bytes/data/security realities.
fusion.promotion_rule: No candidate or fusion is promoted merely because it composes; require exact refreshed-head semantic/regression evidence plus deterministic one-file EntityOS build/run evidence in the isolated sandbox.
